name: RB-C2 local conic completion within internal gaps only
user_acceptance_scope: User visually considers boundaries within green ROI basically accurate; no numerical accuracy claim
budget: New local-gap branch: at most two integrated revisions on the same already-open QA38. Prior C1 global-curve branch ended after its predeclared three revisions, all failed the fixed primary criterion; those results remain immutable. This adds development iterations, not independent test data. Freeze chosen source before one full400 run.
model: Keep the frozen C1 pilot002 fitter as visible-span geometric baseline. Fit local positive-curvature conics only inside two-sided internal gaps, using nearby observed points, shared curvature, ordering and neighbor spacing. Save distinct pieces and coefficients; do not claim one exact conic for an entire rope.
inputs_to_fitter: B1 visible yellow points only, optical pitch, reference ROI and B1 orange/blue exclusions. No legacy purple points, no hidden proxy targets.
pixel_contract: B1 yellow mask, reference ROI, effective ROI, effective RGB, supported/unknown exclusions are byte-preserved. New smooth mask is uint8 0/255 within effective ROI; original image pixels unchanged. Every new smooth pixel is a model result. Separate geometric_gap mask from nearby-observation fitted curve, both subsets of smooth mask.
prediction_scope: No extrapolation beyond visible support span. Overexposed internal gaps may have conic inference when matching, curvature and spacing evidence allow. Excluded active-rope/unknown pixels stay empty. No physical rope identity or event conclusion.
validation: Independent evaluator hides predeclared x-bands of existing yellow points, refits from remaining points and compares with withheld yellow points plus a straight-line baseline. This is development consistency, not blind-test accuracy or real saturation ground truth. Evaluator freezes its settings separately before execution.
continue_gate: 38 outputs complete, unchanged B1 files and mask constraints pass. Both-camera visible residual/withheld consistency do not show material degradation versus straight interpolation, and visual inspection shows coherent smooth central bridges without obvious adjacent-course jumps. Insufficient cases keep local curves or reject; report coverage and all refusals. If conic adds no consistent benefit over straight baseline, do not label it better.
truth_boundary: No reserved 2026-09-25 media or labels; no new labels invented. User feedback is a qualitative baseline acceptance, not per-pixel ground truth.
devices: No cameras, lights, PLC, relays, line arm, servo, deployment or permission changes
reason_for_new_branch: C1 pilot003 forced a gap-endpoint conic across visible spans; strong-glare left pair0315 yellow agreement fell from .984344 to .772994. C1 best primary-loss gain was 7.906%, below fixed 10% threshold. Stop whole-curve-anchor branch; address this scope mismatch via gap-local modeling. Same metric thresholds, denominators, and inputs; no declaring prior failures successes.
